create_video_crop: create a function that crops a video tensor at specified spatial coordinates with given height and width
create_video_center_crop: create a function that center crops a video tensor to a specified output size tuple
create_video_hflip: create a function that horizontally flips a video tensor along the width dimension
create_video_resize: create a function that resizes a video tensor using bilinear interpolation to a target size
create_video_normalize: create a function that normalizes a video tensor using provided mean and standard deviation lists
